This property is perfect for those who are looking for a peaceful retreat in the countryside. Don't miss out on this opportunity to own a piece of paradise. Contact DNG McGill today in either office in Longford or Carrick on Shannon to schedule a viewing and start your journey to owning this picturesque cottage.
